% A document written for pdflatex that sets \pdfoutput=1 before
% \documentclass, as arXiv asks, with the pdfTeX settings often beside it.
% graphicx, xcolor, and hyperref then load without a driver option. ifpdf's
% \ifpdf takes the DVI branch, in the preamble and in the body, as on any
% page, and so does a test of the register itself. TikZ, which takes the
% driver of graphics, draws its picture, and a PDF included without its
% extension is found. The page is the same as without \pdfoutput.
\pdfoutput=1
\pdfcompresslevel=9
\pdfminorversion=5
\pdfinfo{/Title (A title) /Author (An author)}
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\usepackage{ifpdf}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usepackage[colorlinks]{hyperref}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\ifpdf
  \newcommand\branch{PDF branch}
\else
  \newcommand\branch{DVI branch}
\fi
\ifnum\pdfoutput>0 \newcommand\rawbranch{PDF}\else \newcommand\rawbranch{DVI}\fi
\begin{document}
\section{Colors in \textcolor{blue}{blue}}\label{colors}

Text in \textcolor{red}{red}, \emph{in \textcolor{red}{italic}},
\textsf{in \textcolor{red}{sans}}, and \texttt{in \textcolor{red}{typewriter}}.
A link to section~\ref{colors}, and to \href{https://example.com/}{a site}.\footnote{A
note with a link to section~\ref{colors}.}

Picture: \includegraphics[alt={wide picture}, width=2cm]{test-picture.png}.
After the picture.

Bare: \includegraphics[alt={pdf bare}, width=2cm]{test-pdfpic/box}.
After the bare name.

TikZ: \tikz\draw (0,0) circle (0.5); After the TikZ picture.

Math: $x^2 + y^2 = z^2$. After the math.

\begin{theorem}
A theorem in \textcolor{red}{red}, with a link to section~\ref{colors}.
\end{theorem}

Preamble: \branch. Body: \ifpdf PDF branch\else DVI branch\fi.
Raw: \rawbranch, \ifnum\pdfoutput>0 PDF\else DVI\fi.
\end{document}
